טבלה: ביטוח אחריות זיהום
This table details exclusions related to claims under a pollution liability insurance policy. It specifies scenarios where claims between insured parties or related organizations are not covered.
ממדים: Types of claims/relationships between parties, Conditions for exclusion of coverage

K. Related Persons and Organizations
Any 'claim' made:
By an 'insured' against any other 'insured"; or
Against an 'insured' by an organization or individual:
That wholly or partially controls, owns, operates or manages an 'insured"; or
That is wholly or partially controlled, owned, operated or managed by the 'insured'.
